verdict.rationale: The GitHub README lists 'Pinning Rules (Merchandising)', which covers pinning specific hits for queries. It also lists 'Fields Boosting', but that is field-level relevance weighting, not per-query boosting of individual hits. Both are bare feature-list bullets with no detailed docs in the pack. Missing for 10: synonym definition, hiding/excluding specific hits for specific queries, per-query hit boosting, in-depth docs on pinning rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
